steps.name: The organisation's own grievance cell
steps.when_to_use: First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint / docket number.

steps.name: Public Grievance Officer, Ministry of Labour & Employment
steps.channel: Lodge a grievance via the Public Grievance portal
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance remains unresolved after initial contact with the scheme portal.

note: The PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is operated by the Ministry of Labour and Employment through the EPFO. The first installment is payable after 6 months of continuous service. Since you have completed 6 months, you should first verify your status on the official PM-VBRY portals. If you do not receive the benefit, you may escalate the matter through the Ministry of Labour and Employment's public grievance mechanism.
notes: dropped “PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana Portal”: its source is stated only by a non-official page (angelone.in)
